tagline: Execution-grounded, cross-stage drug-development benchmarks for AI agents
task_philosophy: Context-rich DECISION tasks (project vignette -> go/no-go / ranking / dose / target call), graded on the decision + reasoning against real-data ground truth and end-to-end execution (execution_grader) -- NOT tool-routing keyword matching. The routing-style B1/N1 L1-L4 scoring is retained only as a plumbing sub-check.
model_roster: RealBio roster (frontier flagships + Qwen/DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi + BioMate + Biomni)
design_requirements: leakage-aware (temporal/similarity-stratified) splits for all structure/affinity/VS/target tasks
multi-objective, physical-validity, anti-reward-hacking success metrics (not affinity-only)
execution-grounded scoring where BioMate is differentiated
exclude data-boundary tasks (Phase II/III outcomes, PopPK, survival, RWE)

tracks.T1_molecular_tool_workflow: ADMET/docking/RBFE/QSAR/generation/retrosynthesis — compete + cite external (TDC, PoseBusters, OpenFE, MoleculeACE, GuacaMol, PaRoutes)
tracks.T2_early_stage_target_perturbation: target-ID/druggability, perturbation response, experiment design — compete + cite (Open Targets, PrimeKG, GEARS, Virtual Cell Challenge, BioDiscoveryAgent)
tracks.T3_search_knowledge: literature/evidence retrieval + drug/chem knowledge + KG reasoning — compete + cite (PaperQA2, STaRK-PRIME, ChemBench, MoleculeQA, BioKGBench)
tracks.T4_execution_grounded_cross_stage: OWN/white-space: end-to-end pipeline execution, cross-stage chains, PBPK, dose-from-data, stability, FTO, ABFE, antibody developability

benchmarks.name: leadopt_triage
benchmarks.external_baseline: none direct (decision framing); liabilities from ChEMBL/FDA (B1 ADMET gold)
benchmarks.task: Project vignette: rank a congeneric series for advancement, deprioritize the liability compound, name its dominant liability. Decision graded vs real measured ADMET; live variant grades the ADMET run via execution_grader.
benchmarks.note: First exemplar of the PRACTICAL (decision, not tool-routing) redesign. Same shape rolls across archetypes A/B/D/E/F/G/H/I in the redesign doc.

benchmarks.name: fep_selection
benchmarks.external_baseline: OpenFE / Merck FEP (ranking); decision framing is novel
benchmarks.task: Project vignette: FEP-rank a congeneric series vs the lead, advance the tighter binders, deprioritize the clearly weaker. Decision graded vs real experimental ΔΔG (N1 gold); live variant grades the FEP run's ranking via rbfe_scorer.
benchmarks.note: Archetype E; reuses the N1 rbfe_benchmark experimental ΔΔG as ground truth.

benchmarks.name: dose_decision
benchmarks.task: Project vignette: given a BOIN dose-escalation DLT curve + target, call the MTD (level/mg) and safety flags. Covers the clean case, MTD-not-reached, and toxic-at-starting-dose. Graded by score_mtd_decision (exact/adjacent + flag recognition).
benchmarks.note: Archetype H; reuses the B4 boin_benchmark scenarios as ground truth. Reframes the old routing-style BOIN adapter as a decision task.

benchmarks.name: tissue_exposure
benchmarks.task: Dosing axis 2: does FREE drug reach the target tissue above threshold (CNS Kp,uu) / does a tox organ over-accumulate — plasma PK alone is insufficient. BioMate PBPK white space.
benchmarks.note: PROVISIONAL: Kp,uu values are textbook-level (loperamide P-gp-excluded; oxycodone active uptake) but exact numbers are UNVERIFIED this session (web-search budget exhausted). Verify against cited primary sources before publication.

benchmarks.name: special_population
benchmarks.task: Dosing axis 4: adjust dose for renal/hepatic impairment and DDIs (metformin/eGFR, simvastatin+strong-CYP3A4, enoxaparin/CrCl) + a no-adjustment negative control. Decision/knowledge, label-grounded.
benchmarks.note: PROVISIONAL: dosing actions are class-level correct but exact label cutoffs/wording UNVERIFIED this session (web-search budget exhausted). NOT PopPK modeling (that stays out of scope). Verify against current FDA labels before publication.

benchmarks.name: process_knowledge
benchmarks.external_baseline: FDA/ICH drug-development process (clinical phases, IND content 21 CFR 312, CTD)
benchmarks.task: Knowledge of the long multi-stage development process: next-gate after candidate nomination, IND prerequisites (set), CMC-vs-tox parallelism, can-Phase-III-precede-Phase-I, Phase I objective, next regulatory milestone. Objective structural knowledge (no fabricated durations/attrition).
benchmarks.note: Archetype P. Tests lifecycle/stage-gate understanding, complementing the within-stage decision archetypes.

benchmarks.name: workflow_chain
benchmarks.external_baseline: none (no external end-to-end execution-chain benchmark); N8/N9 flagship
benchmarks.task: Long workflow chains: plan the ordered multi-stage pipeline (RNA-seq QC->align->quant->DE->enrichment->report; WGS->variant->annotate->prioritize; cross-stage hERG remediation loop ADMET->redesign->re-screen->PK->decision). Graded on coverage + order fidelity (LCS) + gate adherence.
benchmarks.note: Archetype W. The PLAN layer is offline-graded here; the EXECUTION layer (run each stage on Batch, grade artifacts) is the N8/N9 flagship, graded by execution_grader on the live stack (GATED, not run speculatively).

benchmarks.name: admet_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Given a compound (SMILES), predict hERG/DILI/Ames/Ro5 class and physchem properties; scored over L1 intent -> L6 output validity.

benchmarks.name: docking_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Given a protein and candidate ligands, rank by predicted affinity (Spearman rho vs experimental Kd).

benchmarks.name: pbpk_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: none (novel - no external PBPK ML benchmark; field is mechanistic: Simcyp/GastroPlus/PK-Sim)
benchmarks.task: Given a compound (SMILES), dose and route, predict PK (Cmax/AUC/t-half); within-2-fold vs published clinical PK.

benchmarks.name: boin_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: TrialBench dose-finding (BOIN itself is a method, not a dataset)
benchmarks.task: Given a BOIN dose-escalation scenario, produce the correct MTD dose decision and safety flags.

benchmarks.name: target_structure_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Given a target (FASTA/UniProt), predict structure and detect the druggable pocket; leakage-controlled splits required.
benchmarks.note: structure_scorer.py (full L6) specified in the plan but adapter currently scores L1-L4; confirm before relying on L6.

benchmarks.name: rbfe_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: OpenFE public benchmark; JACS-FEP (Wang 2015); Merck/Schindler FEP
benchmarks.task: Given a congeneric series and a reference ligand, predict relative binding free energies (ddG); RMSE + Kendall tau vs experimental, on leakage-controlled congeneric series.
benchmarks.note: Adapter scores L1-L4 offline (routing/prereq) + L5-L6 via score_execution(task, output_dir); the dedicated runner that launches openfe_rbfe on Batch is the remaining live-stack piece.

benchmarks.name: qsar_benchmark
benchmarks.task: QSAR regression with explicit activity-cliff stratification.

benchmarks.name: generation_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Goal-directed de-novo generation / multi-parameter optimization.

benchmarks.name: retrosynthesis_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Single/multi-step retrosynthetic route planning + synthesizability.

benchmarks.name: stability_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Accelerated stability / formulation prediction.

benchmarks.name: novelty_fto_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Novelty vs prior art / freedom-to-operate reasoning.

benchmarks.name: ind_narrative_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Generate IND module 2.6.1-style nonclinical narrative; graded on skeleton completion, MRSD, adversity language, phase gating.

benchmarks.name: pipeline_e2e_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: none (novel - no external end-to-end execution benchmark)
benchmarks.task: Grade a full pipeline run (request -> workflow selection -> execution -> QC -> interpretation -> report) against real terminal + S3 output artifacts.

benchmarks.name: cross_stage_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Causally-linked multi-stage reasoning (e.g. hERG liability -> reformulate -> re-screen -> re-estimate PK).

benchmarks.name: target_id_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: Open Targets (gene-disease ground truth); PrimeKG; TxGNN (repurposing); DrugMechDB (MoA)
benchmarks.task: Given a disease/indication, nominate and prioritize druggable targets with evidence; scored vs Open Targets / curated associations. Leakage: temporal split on evidence.

benchmarks.name: perturbation_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: GEARS; PerturBench; Arc Virtual Cell Challenge; BioDiscoveryAgent (experiment design)
benchmarks.task: Predict transcriptional response to genetic/chemical perturbation (incl. unseen perturbations / held-out cell type); context-generalization split required.

benchmarks.name: retrieval_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Literature / evidence retrieval + synthesis grounded in sources; find supporting + missing evidence (connects to the Grounded trust-lattice work).

benchmarks.name: knowledge_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: ChemBench; MoleculeQA; SMolInstruct; BioKGBench; GPQA chem/bio
benchmarks.task: Drug/chemistry knowledge + KG reasoning QA with objective ground truth.
